svg.title: What the simulation proves
svg.text: What the simulation proves, and what only a bench can

text.tspan: 12 of 14 bench checks pass, but under assumptions we chose. Each assumption maps to a bench test that will measure it.
Size, flow at 60 N, force, valve, bubble point, capture 1–5 µm, tap flow, disc
Filter life: 2.2 L until flow halves vs 20 L
The 120 s check counts squeezing time only; with release pauses 500 mL
Not modelled at all: seal leaks, thread wear, shedding, leaching, cost, user
1 · flux vs ΔP for A, B, C
